'''''Utapau Surrenders''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]<ref name="CGP" /> created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> that depicted the capitulation<ref name="CGP" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;[[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The painting was set inside one of Utapau's [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkholes]], and its foreground depicted a [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Clothing/Legends|robed]] [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] individual kneeling before Grievous and presenting him with a [[Staff/Legends|staff]], with three additional similarly dressed figures standing a short distance behind. Also occupying the foreground was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] individual ensnared in a leash held by one of Grievous's four [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. In the background stood hundreds more robed figures below a group of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] flying out from the lowest of three [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]] descending into the sinkhole.<ref name="CGP" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Utapau Surrenders'' appeared in "[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]," a collection of [[in-universe]] illustrations by [[Ryan Church]] included in ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a [[2005]] graphic novel edited by [[Jeremy Barlow]]. The image was also featured on the graphic novel's back cover.<ref name="CGP" />
